values.note: 24 drive-in and 5 walk-in sites, plus a group camp.

sites.source: DNR facility cmp00006 (camping: drive_in_campsites 24, walk_in_campsites 5, group_campsites 1; 'The campground features 29 shaded campsites') + forest map ('Campers may choose from 24 drive-in campsites, five walk-in campsites, and a group camp'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: DNR facility cmp00006 ('vault toilets, garbage cans, and drinking water are available'; 'a hand pump for drinking water'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: First come, first served; the fee is paid online on the day of arrival (or at a state park ranger station) before taking a site. Only the group camp is reservable on ReserveMN.

booking.source: DNR facility cmp00006 ('Same-day advance payments are available for individual and equestrian campsites. ... Reservations for group campsites can be made up to 120 days in advance') + forest map ('No reservations (except for group campsite)'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Minnesota state forest drive-in campsite, taxes included. Paid online on the arrival date or at a state park ranger station; nothing is collected at the campground. DNR state forest fee page, read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('$17 - $22'; 'Fees include taxes'; 'Beginning in 2026, state forest camping fees are paid before you occupy a campsite'; 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site or mail-in payments'), read 2026-11-11

note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground on the southwest shore of Big Birch Lake; shaded sites in hardwoods, some close to the water through the trees, and a group camp. Boat landing and fishing dock; motorboats are allowed on the lake, so weekends can be noisy. --Claude
summary: DNR facility record + forest map + fee page read: 29 sites (24 drive-in, 5 walk-in), vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, $17 incl. tax paid online same day. Not waterfront kept despite the DNR's 'right near the water' (sites under continuous canopy); lakeview lead. Phone conflict: DNR names Sauk Rapids 320-223-7841. Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT re-audit (DNR wording contrary to stored 'not waterfront'): the DNR says 'many of the campsites are located right near the water with direct access'. On imagery the campsite spurs sit in continuous hardwood canopy; the closest, just east of the boat landing at about 45.7731,-94.7687 and 45.7729,-94.7693, are 5-25 m from the shore but entirely under trees, and no site map or photo gives site numbers. Under canopy that is at most a view, so 'not waterfront' kept; a lakeview lead for those shoreline spurs if a photo shows the lake from them.

Phone: 320-616-2525 -> 320-223-7841? The DNR record names the 'Parks and Trails Sauk Rapids Area Office' (320-223-7841) as the campground's manager, and the forest map says 'For group camp reservations or other campground information, contact the Sauk Rapids DNR Office at 320-223-7841.' Neither DNR page gives 320-616-2525.
Fees: the forest map still says 'Fees collected on site', which the 2026 fee page replaces with same-day online payment; the fee note says so.
facilities.showers false (derived) left alone: the DNR describes a primitive campground with vault toilets and doesn't mention showers either way.
Pin 45.77100,-94.77100 is ~140 m from the DNR facility point 45.772261,-94.77115 and among the campsite spurs; no move.
Note cleaned: dropped site counts, vault toilets, hand pump and 'No showers' (fields hold them); 'Group camp reservable by phone' corrected (ReserveMN now takes group reservations).
